sentence: This project builds a modified spinning process that uses wetting to improve fiber cohesion in hemp yarns and textiles.
This project tests whether quantum computing can solve problems in atmospheric, hydrologic, and Earth-system sciences better than conventional methods.
This project designs computers that can process encrypted information so that stolen data stays incomprehensible to an attacker in cloud computing.
This project builds academic programs and a learning community that focus on cybersecurity and cyber intelligence.
This project builds an education program that combines computer science, criminal justice, and intelligence and security studies with cybersecurity.
This project builds an AI-based learning environment that gives tailored practice and feedback to help people learn quantum computing.
This project builds a way to prove that optimized tensor contraction sequences give correct results while still running fast.
This project studies how people apply energy knowledge and weigh cost when they design an energy-efficient house.
This project builds a support service that helps researchers find the help and training they need to use computing resources.
This project makes a plan for using green infrastructure such as rain gardens and bioswales to handle stormwater runoff and urban heat.
This project develops a rapid, low-cost test that uses antibodies to detect Per- And Polyfluoroalkyl Substances.
This project turns a biology lab into a cloud lab where AI plans and runs experiments from plain English instructions using automation.
This project uses machine learning and causal inference to work on infrastructure problems such as water distribution and transportation networks.
This project builds learning materials and hands-on laboratories about deploying, optimizing, and securing foundation models at the network edge.
This project uses an ongoing drought to find out how drought changes the storage, movement, and release of carbon in soils, groundwater, and streams.
